jobs.name: Daily Reddit monitoring + comment drafting — Reddit-agent

payload.text: Run the `reddit.scan_and_draft` + `reddit.monitor_keywords` daily cycle. **Load the `reddit-playbook` skill** and execute end to end via browser automation on old.reddit.com: scan every subreddit in `team.reddit_target_subreddits` (last 24h), score each post on the three-criteria checklist, draft up to 3 comments per the Voice Rules and Quality Checklist, and run the keyword + competitor monitor (`team.target_keywords`). If the account is still in its warm-up window (see `reddit-account` skill), do warm-up actions instead of promotional drafts. File drafts to `wiki/Knowledge/Reddit/Drafts/YYYY-MM-DD.md`. Then surface the batch on the board for sign-off: create_task({ kind: 'routine', assigned_to: 'reddit-agent', title: 'Reddit drafts — <date>', context: '<the up-to-3 drafts + any high-value keyword hits; the co-founder signs off here, then dispatches reddit.post>', priority: 'later' }) with NO notify_channel, then complete_task it. Write the daily digest to `memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md` before closing. If no thread qualifies after a real scan (account rate-limited, no signal hits), log the reason to `memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md` and reply with the single literal token `NO_REPLY`.

jobs.name: Weekly Reddit account health check — Reddit-agent

payload.text: Run the `reddit.account_health` weekly check. **Load the `reddit-account` skill.** Log in via browser on old.reddit.com using `team.reddit_account` and check karma trend, shadowban status, and any account warnings per the health check procedure. Log results to wiki/Knowledge/Reddit/AccountHealth.md. If the account is healthy and karma is trending up, file a brief digest on the board: create_task({ kind: 'digest', assigned_to: 'reddit-agent', title: 'Reddit account health — <date>', context: '<one-line healthy summary + karma trend>', priority: 'later' }) with NO notify_channel, complete_task it, then reply with the single literal token `NO_REPLY` only if you wrote nothing else. If the account is banned, suspended, or shadowbanned, do NOT page the user — instead file a prominent board ticket: create_task({ kind: 'task', assigned_to: 'reddit-agent', title: 'ALERT: Reddit account <status>', context: '<account status + recommended action; this leads the ticket so the co-founder raises it now>', priority: 'today' }) with NO notify_channel, and complete_task with the same alert summary so the co-founder sees it on the board.
